sources: Toshiba TB6612FNG, Driver IC for Dual DC motor, datasheet dated 2026-05-13 (technical content as in the 2014-10-01 edition that LCSC hosts), https://toshiba.semicon-storage.com/info/TB6612FNG_datasheet_en_20141001.pdf?did=10660&prodName=TB6612FNG, read 2026-10-31
pins: p. 2 pin functions (1 … 24) = EasyEDA symbol of C141517 (edakit part import 2026-10-31); outputs, PGND and VM on several pins each

absolute maximum p. 3 (Ta = 25 °C): VM 15 V (VM pins v_max_v), VCC 6 V (vdd_max_v, VCC v_max_v), VIN -0.2 … 6 V (IN1, IN2, STBY, PWM: input v_max_v), VOUT 15 V (vout_max_v, output v_max_v), IOUT 1.2 A per channel (2 A for 20 ms at ≤ 20 % duty, 3.2 A for a 10 ms single pulse), PD 0.78 W IC only (0.89 W on 50 × 50 mm, 1.36 W on 76.2 × 114.3 mm PCB), Topr -20 … 85 °C (t_min_c, t_max_c), Tstg -55 … 150 °C

operating range p. 3 (Ta = -20 … 85 °C): VCC 2.7 … 5.5 V (vdd_op_min_v, vdd_op_max_v – VCC carries the role vcc), VM 2.5 … 13.5 V (VM pins v_op_min_v, v_op_max_v), IOUT 1.0 A at VM ≥ 4.5 V, 0.4 A at 2.5 V ≤ VM < 4.5 V (i_out_max_a 1.0), fPWM 100 kHz max
rth_ja_k_per_w 160: p. 6 PD–Ta curve, 'IC only θj-a = 160 °C/W' (target characteristics)

vih_ratio 0.7, vil_ratio 0.3: p. 5 control and standby input voltage VIH ≥ Vcc × 0.7 (max Vcc + 0.2), VIL ≤ Vcc × 0.3 (min -0.2 V); 200 kΩ internal pull-down on every input: p. 2 pin functions, p. 3 input equivalent circuit
idd_max_a 0.0022: p. 5 ICC max at STBY = Vcc = 5.5 V, VM = 5 V (1.8 mA at 3 V; standby ICC and IM 1 µA max)

outputs: p. 4 H-SW control function (stop and standby: OFF, high impedance); p. 5 Vsat(U+L) 0.7 V max at 1 A, 0.21 V max at 0.3 A (Vcc = VM = 5 V); regenerative diode VF(U), VF(L) 1.1 V max at IF = 1 A
capacitors: p. 7 typical application diagram – C1 10 µF + C2 0.1 µF at VM (4.5 … 13.5 V there), C3 10 µF + C4 0.1 µF at Vcc, 'as close as possible to the IC'

LCSC product data C141517 (2026-10-31): TOSHIBA TB6612FNG(O,C,8,EL, SSOP-24, 5 309 pcs; JLCPCB catalogue 2026-10-31: Extended Part, 5 833 pcs; C88224 is the same MPN under another LCSC number (SSOP-24-208mil, 3 391 pcs)
notes: Dual H-bridge for two DC motors, VCC 2.7–5.5 V logic, VM 2.5–13.5 V (15 V abs. max – a full 3S LiPo at 12.6 V is inside the operating range). Internal regenerative (clamp) diodes on every output, upper and lower – no external diodes. STBY and all inputs have 200 kΩ pull-downs: an open STBY keeps it in standby. No behaviour model for a bridge driver: behavior none. Usually bought as a breakout module (SparkFun ROB-14450, Adafruit 2448 and clones) – this entry is the IC. Library draft.

operating range p. 3: VCC 2.7 … 5.5 V, VM 2.5 … 13.5 V, IOUT 1.0 A (VM ≥ 4.5 V) / 0.4 A, fPWM 100 kHz
electrical p. 5: VIH Vcc × 0.7, VIL Vcc × 0.3, ICC 1.8 / 2.2 mA max, Vsat(U+L), regenerative diode VF 1.1 V max
θj-a 160 °C/W IC only (p. 6); capacitors 10 µF + 0.1 µF at VM and Vcc (p. 7)
2026-10-31: outputs clamp = internal – the Toshiba datasheet names internal regenerative diodes (as read for the library draft)
open: tj_max_c: the datasheet states no maximum junction temperature (thermal shutdown 175 °C typ, design target; Tstg 150 °C)
the internal regenerative diodes have no field in the schema: REQ.missing (flyback) asks for a diode across a motor on an output pin – here a false finding
drive tristate makes a motor net driven only by these outputs an LVL.undefined/open_drain warning – no pin type fits a bridge output
r_out_ohm left out: the datasheet gives only the upper + lower saturation voltage (0.7 V max at 1 A), not one output's resistance
fPWM 100 kHz max has no field (f_max_hz is an MCU clock limit) – pin hint on PWMA/PWMB
VIH max is Vcc + 0.2 V while the absolute maximum VIN is 6 V regardless of Vcc – whether an input may sit above Vcc is not stated; vin_rel_max_v left out
the capacitors come from the typical application diagram, a reference circuit, not a requirement table
i_out_max_a 1.0 A holds at VM ≥ 4.5 V; 0.4 A below – one number in the entry
mpn 'TB6612FNG(O,C,8,EL' as LCSC and JLCPCB list it (closing parenthesis cut off); Toshiba's orderable name is not printed in the datasheet
